summary: EESTI ENERGIA AS (LEI 5493005044RTLQ5RZU70, Estonian registry code 10421629) is identifier-confirmed. The Government of Estonia is reported as a controlling owner and shareholder, per Wikidata and OpenSanctions respectively, making this a possible state-owned enterprise; these are indicative findings from aggregator sources, not authoritative register determinations. The Estonian e-Business Register (e-Äriregister) records four current board members — Andrus Durejko and Marlen Tamm (from 2023-04-03), Lauri Karp (from 2024-09-10), and Gerrit Mäesalu (from 2026-06-22) — alongside several persons recorded under "other means," including Jürgen Ligi (from 2024-08-02). Two structural risk signals are raised: a medium-confidence indicator of complex ownership layers (three or more corporate layers per GLEIF data), and a medium-confidence possible state-controlled enterprise indicator sourced from Wikidata. Additionally, related party Jürgen Ligi is name-matched — without confirmed birth date or nationality — against PEP records on OpenSanctions, EveryPolitician, and OpenAleph (medium confidence each); this is a possible name match only and does not constitute a confirmed PEP association. A material limitation applies: OpenSanctions data is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0 and may not be used for commercial purposes.

claims.text: EESTI ENERGIA AS is identifier-confirmed, registered in Estonia with LEI 5493005044RTLQ5RZU70 and Estonian registry code 10421629.

The Government of Estonia is indicatively reported as a controlling owner of Eesti Energia, per Wikidata (a crowd-sourced knowledge base), and as a shareholder per OpenSanctions; these are aggregator-sourced findings, not authoritative register determinations.

This state-control indicator makes EESTI ENERGIA AS a possible state-owned enterprise; this is a structural observation and not an adverse finding. The indicator is presence-only (Wikidata-sourced), meaning its absence is not evidence to the contrary.

The Estonian e-Business Register records four current board members: Andrus Durejko (from 2023-04-03), Marlen Tamm (from 2023-04-03), Lauri Karp (from 2024-09-10), and Gerrit Mäesalu (from 2026-06-22).

The Estonian e-Business Register also records several persons connected to EESTI ENERGIA AS under 'other means,' including Gerrit Mäesalu (from 2026-07-06), Anna Broughel (from 2025-06-02), Priit Rohumaa (from 2025-06-02), Lauri Karp (from 2024-09-11), Jürgen Ligi (from 2024-08-02), Kristi Klaas (from 2024-06-10), Andrus Durejko (from 2023-04-18), Kaur Kajak (from 2023-04-18), Marlen Tamm (from 2023-04-18), and Anne Mere (from 2022-07-19).
GLEIF data indicates EESTI ENERGIA AS consolidates at least three direct subsidiaries: Enefit OÜ, Enefit Oy, and ENEFIT INDUSTRY AS.
OpenSanctions also records EESTI ENERGIA AS as holding shareholdings in Enefit Green and Attarat Power Co.

A medium-confidence structural risk signal identifies complex ownership layers, with the ownership chain reaching three or more corporate layers (the GLEIF-derived AMLA threshold), warranting further review.

GLEIF reports a NON_CONSOLIDATING exception for both the direct and ultimate accounting consolidation parent, meaning no consolidating parent is disclosed to GLEIF; this is a permitted exception under LEI ROC policy and is a structural observation, not a risk finding.

Related party Jürgen Ligi is name-matched — with no birth date or nationality confirmed in common — against PEP records on OpenSanctions, EveryPolitician, and OpenAleph (including via 'US CIA World Leaders,' 'Wikidata Politically Exposed Persons,' and 'MySociety's EveryPolitician Legislators'); all matches are medium confidence and do not constitute a confirmed PEP association.

State-control and shareholder ownership data for the Government of Estonia are sourced from Wikidata (crowd-sourced) and OpenSanctions (aggregator), not from an authoritative national register; these findings are indicative only.
GLEIF Level 2 data reflects accounting consolidation, not beneficial ownership; no beneficial owner is disclosed in the GLEIF record.
The NON_CONSOLIDATING reporting exception means no consolidating parent entity is reported to GLEIF for either the direct or ultimate parent level (f1, f2).

The PEP signals for Jürgen Ligi are name-match only, with no corroborating identifiers (birth date, nationality) to confirm the related party is the same individual as the PEP record (r5, r6, r7, r8, r9).

risks.label: No parent in GLEIF (permitted reporting exception)
risks.rationale: No accounting-consolidation parent is reported to GLEIF: NON_CONSOLIDATING for the direct and ultimate parent (its controlling legal entities are not subject to preparing consolidated financial statements). Structural context, not a risk finding — these are permitted exceptions under the LEI ROC policy, and GLEIF Level 2 records accounting consolidation, not beneficial ownership.

risks.label: Complex ownership layers
risks.rationale: Ownership chain has 3 corporate layers (AMLA threshold: ≥3).

risks.label: State-controlled (possible SOE)
risks.rationale: A controlling owner is a state or state body — a possible state-owned enterprise. Corroborating indicator (Wikidata-sourced); not a determination, and its absence is not evidence the entity is privately owned.

risks.label: Outside EU/EEA
risks.rationale: Ownership chain reaches jurisdictions outside the EU/EEA: JO. Structural context, not a risk finding — neither the AMLA CDD RTS nor AMLR Annex III treats non-EU status as a risk factor in itself. Contributes to AMLA Article 12(1) condition (b) only where it appears on the layered ownership path.
